title: Configured repository entry point does not exist
description: The project profile declares AGENTS.md as an entry point, but the resource is absent.

location.reason: The configured resource does not exist in the controlled snapshot.

evidence.expected: AGENTS.md exists as a repository entry point

analysis.observation: The profile contains AGENTS.md in entry_points and the controlled snapshot contains no AGENTS.md resource.

impact.statement: Agents and contributors may lack a configured operating entry point.

confidence.rationale: The configuration and resource inventory can be compared deterministically.

treatment.rationale: A configured entry point is missing with high confidence and material navigation impact.

recommendation.summary: Add AGENTS.md or remove it from the approved entry-point configuration.

review.notes: Approved by the human Tech Lead during Batch 01 review.
